data.title: Gülermak Group Tightens Grip on Heavy Industry Contractor with Share Purchase
data.description:
Gulermak Agir Sanayi Insaat Ve Taahhut A.S. ( (TR:GLRMK) ) has provided an update.

Gülermak Emlak Yapı İnşaat Yatırım A.Ş., a major shareholder within the Gülermak Group, has increased its stake in Gülermak Ağır Sanayi İnşaat ve Taahhüt A.Ş. through a share purchase on 18 September 2026. The transaction, involving shares with a nominal value of TL 2.5 million at prices between TL 124 and TL 135, lifted its capital ownership from 46.26% to 47.04% and its voting rights from 60.50% to 60.76%.

The move is explicitly framed as a sign of confidence in the company’s operations, growth potential and capacity to generate long-term value, reinforcing the parent group’s strategic commitment. By consolidating its position, Gülermak Group strengthens its influence over the construction contractor, which may provide greater stability for governance and signal continued support to investors monitoring ownership dynamics and control within the company.

Turkey’s Central Dematerialised System has announced multiple transformations of existing shares into trading shares on the exchange under the Capital Markets Board’s Communiqué on Shares, Article 15. The list spans various sectors, including energy, real estate, industrials and aviation, and covers issuers such as Smart Güneş Enerjisi Teknolojileri, Akfen Yenilenebilir Enerji, Aksa Enerji and Türk Hava Yolları.

These transformations enable previously non-tradable or restricted holdings, including 4.5 million units of Smart Güneş Enerjisi Teknolojileri shares, to become eligible for exchange trading subject to settlement and disclosure rules. The move increases free-float liquidity across the named issuers, potentially affecting share price dynamics and providing additional flexibility for existing shareholders and institutional investors under the regulated conversion and memorandum-of-information framework.

data.title: Net Holding Nears 10% Treasury Stake as Share Buy-Back Advances
data.description:
An announcement from Net Holding A.S. ( (TR:NTHOL) ) is now available.

Net Holding A.Ş. has been executing a share buy-back program approved by its extraordinary general assembly, authorizing the board to repurchase up to 18.2 million shares, equivalent to 3.64% of capital, with a fund allocation of TL 850 million over a defined multi-year window. The program aims to support fair share valuation, mitigate extraordinary negative price movements driven by macroeconomic or geopolitical factors, and enhance liquidity in its stock on Borsa İstanbul.

Under this framework, the company repurchased shares on 18 September 2026 at prices between TL 37.70 and TL 38.68, lifting treasury ownership to 9.84% of its own capital, close to the 10% statutory ceiling for buy-backs. The scheme includes strict limits on daily volumes, total cost and price bands tied to book value, and empowers the board to suspend or terminate purchases based on market conditions, underscoring active capital management and signaling support for shareholders amid volatility.

The program targets the company’s B group shares, representing up to about 0.74% of its capital, signaling management’s willingness to support the stock and potentially enhance shareholder value.
